proposal: Contract pieces SPEC §22 implies (Simpler by default, W11; JM-D46 to JM-D54 proposed 2026-11-01, owner to confirm). Each entry is a JSON Pointer into a contract under contracts/ (an endpoint for TABLE API-27a) and the value added there; the core sends and accepts the pieces as written here until the contracts adopt them, after which python -m jana_tools codegen picks them up and the allowances lapse. No storage change: Study's two device-local keys (study_opened:<profile_id>, study_more:<profile_id>) live in the device database's existing app_settings table (JM-D50, keyed by the internal profile id as map_opened_at is under JM-D45, read back through the existing Study open and erased with the profile by the lesson_positions eraser), and no consent, switch, notice, event or data class is new. Every pointer was checked against the file on 2026-11-01.

additions.why: The sign-up choice shows the feature's first-use notice with its consent (the same sentences, the same shipped notice version), so the core records the notice accepted in the same request, as the study_materials branch of PUT /v1/profiles/{id}/consents/{scope} already does without a field (api/profiles.py line 374–381). Optional: a client before W11 sends nothing and the core behaves as today. Refused with validation_failed on any action but on, or on a scope whose online feature has no first-use notice.

value.description: With action `on` on `cloud_tier` or `study_materials`: the plain-words text shown with this consent included the feature's one-time first-use notice (ARC-10), so the core records that notice as accepted for this profile in the same request. `validation_failed` with any other action or scope.

additions.why: The core names each section's group from one table (config/support.py settings_sections), so the four Settings groups have one source of truth; the client's SETTINGS_GROUPS is the same table for a core that omits the field. Optional, so a reply from a core before W11 still validates and a section with no group goes under Help and diagnostics.

value.description: The Settings group this section is shown under (SPEC §22.4.3): Tutor and online, Profiles, Data and privacy, Help and diagnostics. A section with no group is shown under Help and diagnostics.

additions.why: The More panel a learner last opened in Study, remembered on this computer for this profile.

What Study opens on: the material last opened on this computer for this profile (null when none, or when the source or its revision no longer exists) and the More panel last chosen. Device-local operational state in app_settings under study_opened:<profile> and study_more:<profile>, keyed by the internal profile id as map_opened_at is (engine/learner_map.py OPENED_KEY), never a Settings key (a Settings write appends a synced setting_change learning event, store/settings.py line 100–107), never egress, erased with the profile by the lesson_positions eraser.
Study's existing open (POST /v1/study/session) returns where to open, so no new read route is needed. Optional: a core before W11 omits it and the client opens the library.

value.description: Where Study opens (SPEC §22.5.2): the material last opened on this computer for this profile, and the More panel last chosen.

additions.why: The one write Study's More needs of its own: the panel chosen.

A More panel's choice is remembered on this computer. Writes study_more only (study_opened is written by the existing POST /v1/study/sources/{source_id}/open, and both are read back through StudyVisit.view); appends no learning event (the event log's newest seq is unchanged, §22.8).
